senses.gloss:
spanda
(‘vibration’)
------------------------------------------
This is a typical technical term used by one of the schools of काश्मीर् शैविस्म्.
Based on the Śivasūtras of Vasugupta (9th century A. D.), Kalhaṭa or Kallaṭa (A. D. 854) wrote a small work of 51 verses called Spandakārikā which expounds the theory of स्पन्द.
Śiva is the supreme Lord. When his शक्ति or inherent power starts the process of च्रेअतिओन्, with the very first wave or vibration, it is called स्पन्द. The 36 evolutes are manifested out of this.
See ŚAIVISM.
